card.title: Default Decision-Maker
card.instruction: Take charge of every small practical choice, treating speed and efficiency as proof that you should remain in charge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Chairs face the window. I've moved them while you were deciding.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The speaker's at the other end.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then moving the speaker is quicker than moving twelve chairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then everyone turns their own chair. Twelve jobs at once. I'll count you in.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 moves chairs during indecision; A3 prefers moving one speaker; A5 organizes simultaneous chair turning as efficiency leadership.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 wrong end prompts A3 one-person move; B4 already speaking prompts A5 parallel audience movement.

relationship.evidence: B2 identifies the orientation error and B4 rules out disrupting the active speaker.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 constraint to invent another fast coordinated operation with A still directing it.

specificity.evidence: A1 chairs, B2 speaker and A3 twelve seats establish the spatial problem concretely.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 twelve jobs at once turns the correction of A's own error into proof of efficient command.
